notes: kb/Work PB5191 landed. §1985:VI.5.4.3 SR1: "The BLANK WHEN ZERO clause can be specified only for an elementary item whose PICTURE is specified as numeric or numeric edited". CheckElementaryOnlyClauses refuses the clause on a group entry (COBOL2403) and CheckClauseSubjectsPass.Run, through BlankWhenZeroViolation, on an elementary item whose category is not numeric or numeric edited (COBOL2405). PictureComposition.Validate bars only the asterisk beside the clause below 2002 (§1985:VI.5.9.3 SR7; S and * from 2002, §2002:13.16.38.2 SR18), and AnalyzeCharacterString promotes a signed numeric picture with the clause to numeric edited at 85 (§1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2), the S leaving the edit mask (§1985:VI.5.9.4 GR8: not counted in the size), so PIC S9(4) BLANK WHEN ZERO is four positions, blank at zero. Witnesses: 1985-SR-VI_5_4_3-1 (PIC X(3) refused) and pb5191-signed-numeric-blank-when-zero-85 ([    ], [0012], [0012]).

next.reason: 1985 admits BLANK WHEN ZERO for any elementary item 'whose PICTURE is specified as numeric or numeric edited'; no 1985 rule bars the symbol S. §2023:13.18.8.3 SR1 narrows this to 'category numeric-edited or ... numeric without the picture symbol S', so PIC S9(4) BLANK WHEN ZERO, legal in 1985, is refused. §2023:13.16.3 SR11 keeps the elementary-only part. The usage requirement (§2023:13.18.8.3 SR2) answers 1985 SR2, not this rule. Both are compile-time rules.
